label: The transferable hub contract is four root files (SKILL.md, mode-registry.json, hub-router.json, ROUTER.md) plus a generated leaf-manifest.json and advisor metadata; the hub holds no per-mode logic and each mode keeps its contract in its packet.

Advisor routingClass is metadata for all three modes: resolved by hub membership with one advisor identity, no per-mode map entry or merged-identity projection; this closes 005's open question with no projection maps needed.

packetKind is workflow for all three browser modes and the new registry drops mcp-tooling's extensions.transport-axis block entirely: all modes mutate state, so no transport tool surface and no sk-design crossHubPairing.
backendKind is cli-plus-mcp for all three; Bladebro qualifies because its CLI and MCP share handlers, so the new hub needs no code-mode-remote-mcp or figma-desktop-transport kinds.

Proposed mode-registry.json shape: skill/version/resourceContractVersion/description/discriminator/advisorRoutingContract plus modes[] of length 3, each workflow plus cli-plus-mcp, Write/Edit allowed, mutatesWorkspace true, packet equal to packetSkillName, grandfatheredFolderMismatch false, command null, advisorRouting routingClass metadata; exact name strings deferred to KQ5.

Proposed hub-router.json shape: three routerSignals of weight 4 with classes and per-mode SKILL.md resources, vocabularyClasses keywords, defaultMode null, fallback-only defaultResource, and a discovery-only browser-generic defer class; tieBreak must encode Chrome-Bladebro and Aside-Bladebro overlap.

Proposed leaf-manifest.json shape: three generated modes[] entries of leaves/packet/workflowMode; Chrome and Aside leaves carry over, Bladebro leaves are greenfield because no *bladebro* file exists under .skilled/skills, so 004 must author them before regeneration; never hand-edit.

New hub needs its own ROUTER.md with DEFAULT_RESOURCE empty and machine-readable INTENT_SIGNALS and RESOURCE_MAP mapping packet-qualified leaves to canonical workflowMode/leafResourceId pairs; every path must resolve on disk and be in the generated manifest.

Cross-file consistency is part of the contract: registry modes and router signal keys bidirectionally aligned, escalate when registry/stage-one/stage-two/manifest disagree, SKILL.md version is authority, and one graph-metadata identity with three member entities names mcp-code-mode as external substrate.
Bladebro has no packet under .skilled/skills (glob **/*bladebro* returned no files on 2026-11-21); its leaf set is greenfield for 004-bladebro-mode.
